versions.changelog:
Initial release — Backward schedules multi-dish holiday or party meals for simultaneous serving.

- Generates a detailed, minute-by-minute kitchen timeline starting from desired serve time
- Manages oven and burner as limited shared resources, accounting for shelf and temp constraints (±25°F co-bake)
- Automatically shifts dishes within their hold/rest windows to resolve conflicts
- Marks make-ahead dishes to avoid day-of competition for resources
- Detects and warns about hands-on prep timing collisions
- Performs feasibility checks and suggests earliest possible serve time if schedule is impossible
